contracts: Only consecutive absolute .a arguments are replaced; each run stays at its original position with exact internal order.
Whole-archive, group, driver, target, sysroot, search, generated-object and output arguments remain unchanged.
Every response archive path must be a bound receipt input.
Response data exists only in memfds and is double-quoted with LLVM GNU response escaping.
Actual response contents are hashed after allocation and rechecked after link; original and adapted argument templates and archive sequences are separately hashed.
The shared descriptor map carries response memfds through existing guard reopening/pass_fds and closes them in existing execute finally.
Existing no-temp environment and no-mmap output flag remain unchanged.
Sanitized rejection evidence includes response hashes and counts without response bytes or command text.
remaining: Independent source review and actual anonymous link/run are required.
